label: Atrocity From Permission
statement: The worst atrocities flow from felt divine permission.
description: Premise 1 of the morality without god.

label: Beginning Needs Beginner
statement: Whatever begins to exist has a cause/beginner.

label: Burden Remains
statement: The theist must still bridge from designer to revealed God.
description: Premise 2 of the deism theism gap.

label: Capricious Or Absent
statement: Heat death and collisions imply capricious or no design.
description: Premise 2 of the argument from poor design.

label: Cause Is Transcendent
statement: The creator-cause is spaceless, timeless, immaterial, intelligent, powerful, and personal.

label: Chance Insufficient
statement: Such precision is not plausibly due to chance.
description: Premise 2 of the argument from fine tuning.

label: Conscience Is Innate
statement: Conscience (Socrates, Smith) is innate, not granted.
description: Premise 3 of the morality without god.

label: Designer Inferred
statement: A mind best explains biological information.
description: Premise 3 of the argument from design of life.

label: Designer Not Pray-Answerer
statement: A designer need not answer prayer or perform miracles.
description: Premise 1 of the deism theism gap.

label: Fine-Tuning Observed
statement: Physical constants are set on a razor's edge.
description: Premise 1 of the argument from fine tuning.

label: Information From Minds
description: Premise 2 of the argument from design of life.

label: Lawgiver Is God
statement: That standard is the moral lawgiver, God's nature.

label: Life Carries Information
description: Premise 1 of the argument from design of life.

label: No Unique Believer Virtue
statement: No moral act is available only to believers.
description: Premise 2 of the morality without god.

label: Objective Values Exist
statement: Objective moral values and duties exist.

label: Tuner Inferred
statement: A fine-tuner best explains the balance.
description: Premise 3 of the argument from fine tuning.

label: Values Need Lawgiver
statement: Objective values require a standard beyond humanity.

label: Waste And Extinction
statement: Profuse creation is mostly wiped out; 99.8% of species are extinct.
description: Premise 1 of the argument from poor design.
